load_word_length_measurement: load the word_length measurement module from the Hugging Face evaluate library
launch_gradio_widget: launch a gradio widget for the word_length measurement module
evaluate_word_length: evaluate word length statistics on text input using the word_length measurement module
compute_word_length_stats: compute word length statistics such as mean, median, and distribution for a given text
run_word_length_measurement: run the word_length measurement on sample text and return length metrics
